title: Type-level dl:ok review
summary: One dl:ok on an enum type declaration reviews every unused-enum-value or enum-ordinal-cast finding of that type, in any unit
intro: Read this when an enum mirrors ordinals stored outside the code (a DB byte, a wire protocol, streaming) and its filler values or ordinal casts are deliberate: one `dl:ok <rule-id>` on the type line reviews them all, instead of one marker per value or cast.

questions.ask: Silence every unused filler value of one enum at once
questions.command: add `// dl:ok unused-enum-value -- <reason>` on the line that declares the type

questions.ask: Accept every ordinal cast of a wire-protocol enum
questions.command: add `// dl:ok enum-ordinal-cast -- <reason>` on the line that declares the type
